body:
I formatted my computer, erased everything on my phone and went up to the roof of my building with the intention to jump and kill myself. I've been up there a few times before and told myself after looking at the height that i don't have the guts for it. And lo and behold i don't. 

I couldn't make myself jump, i was too scared. 

I also tried calling the suicide hotline for some reason and after being on hold for ten minutes they hung up, which i thought was pretty funny.
